# Malibu

> Malibu is a coordinated inference network that turns idle Apple Silicon Macs into AI inference providers. Providers keep open-source models warm and earn credits for verified inference; USDC-on-Base payouts are planned for public beta. Buyers use an OpenAI-compatible gateway at api.malibu.tech, and paid requests settle on signed inference receipts checked by the network.

## Blog

- [Turning on the world's biggest AI cloud](https://malibu.tech/blog/turning-on-the-worlds-biggest-ai-cloud/): The manifesto — why 200M idle Apple Silicon Macs already hold more consumer AI compute than the top three hyperscalers combined, and how Malibu turns it on.

## Product

- [Host a model](https://malibu.tech/host/): Turn a stock Apple Silicon Mac into an inference provider. Invite required in pre-beta.
- [Agent-readable onboarding](https://get.malibu.tech/skill.md): Point a coding agent here to install the provider CLI, check status, recover a broken setup, update or uninstall, and connect apps to the OpenAI-compatible API at api.malibu.tech.
- [Console](https://malibu.tech/console/): Point any OpenAI SDK client at Malibu; nothing else changes.
- [Network](https://malibu.tech/network/): Live network stats and coverage.
